assessments.reasoning: The pinned SPDX file AGPL-3.0-or-later.xml has licenseId="AGPL-3.0-or-later" and name="GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later". The complete license start tag lacks deprecatedVersion. The notes distinguish this choice from version 3 alone and point to the file notice. The marked header inside text/optional expressly offers both choices. The connector reported 44102 bytes and SHA-256 80cf96735110149f5c606f2f444f9a44006bc41bb717044c058b35b8be08819d.

The pinned SPDX field guide identifies licenseId and name as the identifier and title, and deprecatedVersion as the first SPDX release marking identifier deprecation. The guide assigns isOsiApproved a separate meaning. Its presence in both the or-later and historical entries therefore cannot decide deprecation. Direct inspection shows the deprecation attribute in the historical tag and its absence in the or-later tag. The guide's connector-reported 13200-byte body has SHA-256 ec26e007778d0905e76097148c795898795ba9d2974d099bdc8f06544235ee6c.

limitations: This finding covers the named XML representation and example notice. A work's actual version choice depends on its applicable grant.
The SPDX template includes matching markup. Its bytes do not establish the FSF plaintext bytes or permission to redistribute the composite XML.
The connector-reported claim digest matched the frozen revision. The connector supplied no numeric ranges, and I inspected the named fields directly without independently recomputing the hashes.
reasoning: The pinned AGPL-3.0-or-later entry identifies the choice of version 3 or any later version in its full name, notes and marked example notice. Its opening license tag omits deprecatedVersion.
